data.title: PBS NewsHour: Midterm voters rebuke Trump, handing Democrats both chambers of Congress
data.author: Amalia Huot-Marchand
data.summary: Voters delivered a sweeping rebuke of President Trump and his party in the midterms, handing Democrats major victories and dramatically reshaping the balance of power in Washington. Liz Landers reports.
